roman_urdu_transliteration: Tarjuma-e-Ma'lumaat-ul-Aafaq 123. Aaftab ki shua ke aks se hoti hai aur jo hawa ki pani satah aur zameen se mili hui hai woh kura-e-zamhareeri se ziyada sard hoti hai jaisa ki un maqamon mein jo qutb-e-shumali ke ghair hein aur wahan chhe mahine aaftab nahi nikalta hai aur wahan ki sardi bahut sakht hoti hai aur pani hawa ke neeche jam jata hai aur haiywanat aur nabatat ki bunyad nahi baqi rehti hai aur hawa mein ajaib hain aur faqeer ajeeb hain ki kabhi noor aur kabhi tareeki aur kabhi bukharat aur kabhi dukhan aur kabhi baad-e-mukhalif aur kabhi raad aur kabhi barq aur kabhi saaqa aur kabhi subaiha aur kabhi ola aur kabhi sardi ho jati hai. Insha-Allah Ta'ala un mein ka zikr hoga badli ki paidaish ke bayan mein aur azizan-e-hakeemoon ka bayan ke jab aaftab zameen mein taaseer karta hai zameen aur pani ke ajza tehleel hoti hein aur ajza-e-aab ko bukhar kehte hein aur ajza-e-zameen ko dukhan kehte hein aur jab bukhar aur dukhan buland hota hai hawa isko ek taraf numuna taraf le jati hai aur asar ko us jagah tak pohanchati hai phir farman-e-bari ta'ala ka hukm hota hai aur ooper ke kura se kura-e-zamhareeri se aur nahi bhi sakti aur chattano se takra ke ruk jati hai aur usi wajah se sard aur khafeef ho jati hai aur isko badli kehte hein aur badli ke jab ooper ki janib buland hoti hai aur ba'ne ajza o isko toot jati hein aur jo zameen mada dukhani hai woh rih ho jata hai aur jo mada bukhari hai woh pani ho jata hai phir parda-e-pani muntashir ho ke qatra-e- ho jata hai aur yeh saqeel hota hai asfal ki taraf rujoo hota hai aur woh hi meena hota hai aur agar bukhar shab ko suood karta hai aur hawa sard hoti hai sardi suood se mani hoti hai woh ikattha ho ke barik badli ban jata hai aur agar sardi had se ziyada hoti hai woh hi afsurda ho ke badli se barf ho jata hai kyunki ajza ki maili sajati hein aur ajza ki hawai paraganda ho jata hai zameen meena angni kar neeche aata hai aur olowat quwwat ke sath barasta hai aur hawa agar sard ho to bukhar aur dukhan jama ho ke dhunki hui megni ki tarah ho jata hai
